FIELDS.NAME: Eternal Vows Wedding Chapel
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Wedding Lane, Suite 100, Bliss City, CA 90210-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Eternal Vows Wedding Chapel specializes in providing beautiful wedding ceremonies in our elegant chapel setting. We offer a range of personalized services, including wedding planning and coordination, floral arrangements, and photography. Our venue can accommodate intimate ceremonies for up to 100 guests, ensuring a warm and inviting atmosphere for couples and their loved ones. We strictly maintain a no alcohol policy on the premises to minimize liability and enhance the safety of our events. Our staff is well-trained in emergency procedures and we have a comprehensive risk management plan in place to ensure a smooth and stress-free experience for all our clients. All vendors are required to have proper insurance coverage, and we work exclusively with licensed service providers to reduce direct liability. We are committed to upholding the highest standards of service and safety for every wedding we host.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in providing or serving alcohol on the premises, nor does it offer overnight accommodations. Additionally, we confirm that all events hosted do not exceed 300 attendees, and the business operates with all required local permits and licenses in full compliance.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred from two separate incidents in the last three years: The first incident on June 12, 2021, involved a miscommunication with a vendor, leading to an additional $1,000 spent on floral arrangements to meet client expectations. The second incident on September 22, 2022, was a minor property damage claim due to an unexpected leak, totaling $1,500 in repairs. Both incidents are resolved, and measures have been implemented to enhance vendor communication and property maintenance.
